title: A **12-month** rollout from pilot districts to scaled clusters lets the company validate unit economics before expanding fleet capacity and coverage
subtitle: Illustrative phased path from initial pilots to scaled operating clusters, with each step tied to proof points before the next capacity build

phases.title: Pilot design locks target crops, districts, partner terms, and service SOPs before field launch
phases.body: Define pilot scope for **2** districts, **3** crops, and **1** operating playbook; set commercial terms, lead routing, and spray-quality checks.

phases.title: District pilots test demand conversion and delivery reliability before broader capacity commitments
phases.body: Run pilots with **4** partners and **8** drones; track leads, booked demos, quoted acreage, completed jobs, and repeat demand by district.

phases.title: A mid-year economics gate determines whether expansion follows proven contribution margins and utilisation
phases.body: At **Month 6**, review pilot metrics against **3** thresholds: partner productivity, drone utilisation, and signed acreage conversion.

phases.title: Scaled clusters expand coverage only after the model works, adding capacity in sequenced waves
phases.body: Expand to **6** clusters with **12** partners and **24** drones by **Month 12**, then widen district coverage through the same partner-led playbook.
